content: ऐरावतः [इरा आपः तद्वान् इरावान् समुद्रः तस्मादुत्पन्नः अण्] .²1 <ab>N.</ab> of the elephant of Indra. ऐरावतं गजेन्द्राणाम् <ls>Bg. 10. 27</ls>. .²2 An excellent elephant; a species of elephant; ऐरावतानैन्द्रशिरान्नागान्वै प्रियदर्शनान् <ls>Rām. 2. 70. 23</ls>. .²3 One of the chiefs of the Nāgas or serpent-race (inhabiting Pātāla); अहमैरावत ज्येष्ठभ्रातृभ्योऽकरवं नमः <ls>Mb. 1. 3. 139</ls>. .²4 The elephant presiding over the east. .²5 A kind of rainbow. .²6 A kind of lightning; (said to be {%n.%} also in these two senses). .²7 The orange tree. .{@-तम्@} .²1 A vast and waterless region. .²2 (<ab>pl.</ab>) <ab>N.</ab> of a Varṣa. .²3 <ab>N.</ab> of the northern path of the moon. .²4 A kind of cloud; ‘मेघस्योपरि मेघो यः स ऐरावत उच्यते’ इति दक्षिणावर्तः (Commentator of मेघदूत). .{@-ती@} .²1 The female of Indraʼs elephant. .²2 Lightning. .²3 <ab>N.</ab> of a plant (वटपत्री) .²4 <ab>N.</ab> of river Rāvī in the Panjab (= इरावती). .²5 <ab>N.</ab> of a particular portion of the moonʼs path.
